news.title: Person in custody after shooting on Moreland Avenue, police say
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department says a suspect is in custody after a 63-year-old man was shot multiple times and had to be taken to a hospital.

news.title: Man survives after shots fired into DeKalb County home Saturday
news.summary: A man is recovering after someone fired shots into a DeKalb County home with multiple people inside Saturday night.

news.title: Man wanted on child molestation, sodomy charges arrested after foot chase
news.summary: A 23-year-old Atlanta man wanted on multiple charges, including child molestation and sodomy, was arrested in Habersham County after deputies say he ran into a wooded area during a traffic stop.

news.title: 'Young man' dies in domestic shooting, DeKalb County police say
news.summary: DeKalb County police are investigating a shooting after officers found a young man shot to death in the 4400 block of Lincoln Jones Road Saturday evening.

news.title: Late-night gunfire in southeast Atlanta leaves bystander hurt
news.summary: A 63-year-old bystander is in the hospital after gunfire erupted during a fight between a suspect and a security guard late Saturday night on Moreland Avenue SE in Atlanta.

news.title: Every 40 seconds, someone has heart attack in US; How to recognize when you’re in cardiac arrest
news.summary: One in five of heart attacks are silent, meaning the person having the heart attack doesn’t even know they’re having one, according to the Atlanta-based U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

news.title: 27-year-old man injured in shootout with Chamblee officer identified: GBI
news.summary: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) has identified the 27-year-old man who was shot and hospitalized after exchanging gunfire with a Chamblee police officer at a Motel 6 on Saturday morning.

news.title: Murder charges dropped against brother of 'We Ready' rapper Archie Eversole
